THE_QUESTION: What happens when the two strategies share the CNN encoder AND the MLP body, leaving only the per-latent branch trunks, action heads and critics private?

the_decomposition.reading: sharing the encoder did NOT degrade the specialists on their own poles. It RAISED the off-pole latents, most sharply z0@B. Because crossover is a difference, lifting the inappropriate strategy narrows Delta from BELOW rather than eroding the appropriate one from ABOVE.

WHAT_RUNG_1_ESTABLISHED_THAT_MOTIVATES_T.named_mechanism: COMPETENCE LEAKAGE -- shared parameters transfer general task skill between strategies, so the latent playing a pole it was not trained for gets better, and the measured differential shrinks. This is materially different from destructive interference, in which the on-pole specialist itself would decay.

PRIMARY_MECHANISTIC_PREDICTION_FROZEN_BE.statement: If parameter sharing causes competence leakage, Rung 2 will reduce crossover PRIMARILY through increased OFF-POLE performance while preserving ON-POLE performance. A substantial decline in ON-POLE performance instead supports destructive interference.

operationalisation.on_pole_shift: mean over {z0@A, z1@B} of [Rung2 win rate - Rung0 win rate] on the matched 128 seeds
operationalisation.off_pole_shift: mean over {z1@A, z0@B} of [Rung2 win rate - Rung0 win rate]
operationalisation.leakage_signature: off_pole_shift > 0 AND on_pole_shift approximately 0 or only slightly negative (magnitude clearly smaller than off_pole_shift)
operationalisation.interference_signature: on_pole_shift substantially negative, comparable to or larger in magnitude than any off-pole change
operationalisation.reported_as: a PRIMARY reported quantity of the Rung 2 evaluation, not a post-hoc decomposition

PRIMARY_MECHANISTIC_PREDICTION_FROZEN_BE.pole_B_is_the_diagnostic_one: Rung 1's D_B upper bound was only +0.0234 -- 0.023 from crossing into SHARING_DAMAGED_SPECIALIZATION, versus 0.1016 of headroom on D_A. If additional sharing narrows things further, Pole B is predicted to cross first and would be the program's first statistically detectable sharing-induced specialization loss.
PRIMARY_MECHANISTIC_PREDICTION_FROZEN_BE.why_this_is_worth_freezing: either outcome is informative. This is no longer trying architectures until one works; it is deliberately increasing sharing until crossover fractures while measuring HOW it fractures.

CONSTRUCTION.mechanism: two complete actors of the specialists' architecture, one per z, with the z1 branch's actor_cnn AND latent_actor.body modules replaced by the z0 branch's (parameter tying by object identity). Verified by module identity and by unique-parameter arithmetic: unique == n_cnn + n_body + 2*(n_branch - n_cnn - n_body).
CONSTRUCTION.why_the_specialist_architecture_per_bran: unchanged from Rung 1 -- each branch retains the capacity of the teacher it imitates, so any loss cannot be attributed to a smaller per-strategy network. The only change from Rung 1 is that the body is now shared too.
CONSTRUCTION.initialisation: fresh random init, torch.manual_seed(11963001) for branch z0 and 11963002 for branch z1; verified to differ from the specialists' weights
CONSTRUCTION.per_row_dispatch: unchanged -- policy_logits(obs, z_idx) selects per row, so a mixed-z minibatch gives both shared modules gradient from BOTH strategies in the same step

TRAINING_RECIPE_UNCHANGED: 0.5*KL(pi_A||branch_z0) + 0.5*KL(pi_B||branch_z1), same TEACHER_DISTILLATION_DATASET.json rows, 20 fixed epochs, batch 256, Adam lr 3e-4, clip 1.0, no early stopping, no checkpoint selection, terminal weights only, fit check >= 0.50 on teacher-holdout agreement before the eval opens. Critics excluded from the optimizer and verified immobile.
PREFLIGHT_REQUIRED: the same 8 checks as Rung 1, with check 3 extended: BOTH the encoder and the body must be shared by identity, and the unique-parameter arithmetic must match the two-module formula. Gradient must reach both shared modules and both private stacks, with none on any critic.
